title: DecisionRequest
description: Payload sent by SmashCourt-BE to request a reservation decision evaluation from TADSS.

reservationId.description: Unique identifier of the reservation from SmashCourt.

courtTypeId.description: Optional court category identifier (e.g., VIP, Standard).

customerTier.description: Customer loyalty membership tier rank name from database (LoyaltyTier table, e.g. STANDARD, GOLD, VIP).

endTime.description: Reservation end time in UTC (ISO 8601). Must be after startTime.

bookingType.description: Type of booking session (e.g. SINGLE, RECURRING, TOURNAMENT, EVENT).

totalPrice.description: Total calculated price for the booking in VND.

depositAmount.description: Amount already deposited or paid upfront in VND.

paymentStatus.description: Current payment settlement status matching SmashCourt-BE InvoicePaymentStatus.

priority.description: Decision evaluation priority level in TADSS request context (NORMAL, HIGH, VIP, URGENT).

requestedAt.description: Client-side request dispatch timestamp in UTC.
